item.title: Version 0.2.0
item.description:
Daptastic now keeps itself up to date.

  • Automatic updates: new versions arrive as a notification. Click Install… to see what's new and update in place, with no re-downloading and no repeat security prompt.
  • Check for Updates… in the menu-bar menu, and a "Check for updates automatically" switch in Settings and setup.

Updating from 0.1.0: 0.1.0 can't update itself, so install this version by hand once: download Daptastic.dmg and drag it into Applications, replacing the old copy. From here on, updates are automatic.

Requirements: macOS 15 or later, a Navidrome server, and a player that mounts as a USB drive.

First install: this build isn't notarised by Apple yet, so the first time you open it macOS says it can't verify the app. Go to System Settings → Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway.
